SELECT apiId, apiNm, systemId, systemNm, paramNo, paramNm, paramType, paramDesc, currentGrade FROM ( SELECT CAST(A.API_ID AS VARCHAR($n)) as apiId, A.API_NM as apiNm, CAST(MIN(B2.SYS_ID) AS VARCHAR(50)) as systemId, MIN(C.SYS_NM) as systemNm, CAST(MIN(B.PARAM_NO) AS VARCHAR(50)) as paramNo, B.PARAM_NM as paramNm, B.PARAM_TYPE_CD as paramType, B.PARAM_DESC as paramDesc, CASE Latest.SENSITIVITY_LEVEL WHEN '1' THEN '1 등급' WHEN '2' THEN '2 등급' ELSE NULL END as currentGrade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.API_ID, B.PARAM_NM ORDER BY Latest.CREATED_AT DESC) as RN FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A.API_NO = B.API_NO LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SENSITIVITY_LEVEL, CREATED_AT FROM SENSITIVE_INFO_SURVEY S WHERE S.API_ID = A.API_ID AND S.PARAMETER_NAME = B.PARAM_NM ORDER BY S.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) Latest ON TRUE WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.HIDDEN = 'N' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.API_ID, A.API_NM, B.PARAM_NM, B.PARAM_TYPE_CD, B.PARAM_DESC, C.SYS_NM, Latest.SENSITIVITY_LEVEL, Latest.CREATED_AT
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(S.API_ID AS VARCHAR($n)) as apiId, COALESCE(A.API_NM, '') as apiNm, CAST(S.SYS_ID AS VARCHAR($n)) as systemId, S.SYS_NM as systemNm, '0' as paramNo, S.PARAMETER_NAME as paramNm, S.PARAMETER_TYPE as paramType, S.PARAMETER_DESC as paramDesc, CASE S.SENSITIVITY_LEVEL WHEN '1' THEN '1 등급' WHEN '2' THEN '2 등급' ELSE NULL END as currentGrade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.API_ID, S.PARAMETER_NAME ORDER BY S.CREATED_AT DESC) as RN FROM SENSITIVE_INFO_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF A ON S.API_ID = A.API_ID WHERE S.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A2 INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A2.API_NO = B.API_NO WHERE A2.API_ID = S.API_ID AND B.PARAM_NM = S.PARAMETER_NAME ) ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 ORDER BY systemNm, apiId

SELECT A.API_NO as apiNo, A.API_ID as apiId, A.API_NM as apiNm, B2.SYS_ID as systemId, C.SYS_NM as systemNm, B.PARAM_NO as paramNo, B.PARAM_NM as paramNm, B.PARAM_TYPE_CD as paramType, B.PARAM_DESC as paramDesc FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A.API_NO = B.API_NO LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.HIDDEN = 'N' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL AND C.SYS_NM = #{sysnm} ORDER BY C.SYS_NM, A.API_NO

SELECT DISTINCT C.SYS_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A.API_NO = B.API_NO LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.HIDDEN = 'N' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY C.SYS_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_PARAMS, SUM(CASE WHEN B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%imsi%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%imei%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%iccid%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%eid%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%ki%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%opc%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%단말기식별%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%기기식별%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GRADE1_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%주민%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%신용카드%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%계좌%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%name%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%이름%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%address%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%주소%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%phone%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%전화%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%email%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%이메일%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%생년%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%이름%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%주소%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%전화번호%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GRADE2_COUNT FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A.API_NO = B.API_NO WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.HIDDEN = 'N'

SELECT C.SYS_NM, COUNT(*) as TOTAL_PARAMS, SUM(CASE WHEN B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%imsi%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%imei%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%iccid%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%eid%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%ki%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%opc%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%단말기식별%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%기기식별%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GRADE1_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%주민%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%신용카드%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%계좌%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%name%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%이름%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%address%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%주소%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%phone%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%전화%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%email%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%이메일%' OR B.PARAM_NM LIKE '%생년%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%이름%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%주소%' OR B.PARAM_DESC LIKE '%전화번호%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as GRADE2_COUNT FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_PARAM B ON A.API_NO = B.API_NO LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' LEFT JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.HIDDEN = 'N' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY C.SYS_NM ORDER BY GRADE1_COUNT DESC, GRADE2_COUNT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SENSITIVE_INFO_SURVEY ( API_ID, SYS_NM, SYS_ID, SENSITIVITY_LEVEL, PARAMETER_TYPE, PARAMETER_NAME, CREATED_BY, PARAMETER_DESC ) VALUES ( #{apiId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sensitivityLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parameterType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parameterName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parameterDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT apiId, apiNm, sysId, sysNm FROM ( SELECT A.API_ID as apiId, A.API_NM as apiNm, MIN(B2.SYS_ID) as sysId, MIN(C.SYS_NM) as sysNm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(C.SYS_NM), A.API_ID) as RN FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' INNER JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL
AND ( A.API_ID LIKE '%' || #{} || '%' OR A.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%' )
GROUP BY A.API_ID, A.API_NM ) T WHERE T.RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{pageSize} ORDER BY T.RN

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT A.API_ID, A.API_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_API_DPLY B2 ON A.API_ID = B2.IF_NO AND B2.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' INNER JOIN BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY C ON B2.SYS_ID = C.SYS_ID AND C.DPLY_TYPE != 'del' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.SYS_NM IS NOT NULL
AND ( A.API_ID LIKE '%' || #{} || '%' OR A.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%' )
GROUP BY A.API_ID, A.API_NM ) T
